content:
**Best‑selling female rappers – where they’re from**

| Rank (by reported worldwide sales) | Rapper | Birthplace (city / state / country) | Approx. total record sales* | Why she’s on the list |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Nicki Minaj** | Saint James, **Trinidad & Tobago** (born) – grew up in Queens, New York, USA | **≈ 100 million** records (albums + singles) | First female rapper to sell 100 M+ units; “Pink Friday” and “The Pink Print” albums, countless hit singles. |
| 2 | **Cardi B** | The Bronx, **New York, USA** | **≈ 100 million** (including streaming‑equivalent album units) | “Invasion of Privacy” went 3× Platinum; “Bodak Yellow”, “I Like It”, “WAP” gave her massive global streaming numbers that push her past the 100 M‑unit mark. |
| 3 | **Missy Elliott** | Portsmouth, **Virginia, USA** | **≈ 30 million** records | Pioneering producer‑rapper; “Under Construction”, “Missy Elliott 2005”, and a string of hit singles (e.g., “Get Ur Freak On”). |
| 4 | **Lil’ Kim** | Queens, **New York, USA** | **≈ 15 million** records | “Hard Core” (1996) went Platinum; “Lady Marmalade” and “The Notorious K.I.M.” helped cement her as one of the biggest sellers of the late‑’90s/early‑2000s. |
| 5 | **Iggy Azalea** | Sydney, **Australia** | **≈ 10 million** records (incl. streaming) | First Australian female rapper to break into the U.S. mainstream; “The New Classic” and hits like “Fancy” and “Black Widow” drove strong global sales/streams. |
| 6 | **Foxy Brown** | Brooklyn, **New York, USA** | **≈ 5 million** records | “Ill Na Na” era and “The Foxy Brown Compilation” gave her solid sales in the early‑2000s. |
| 7 | **Da Brat** | Chicago, **Illinois, USA** | **≈ 2 million** records | “Funkdafied” (1999) went Platinum; she remains one of the few women to achieve a Platinum rap album in the 1990s. |
| 8 | **Doja Cat** (often classified as rap‑pop) | Los Angeles, **California, USA** | **≈ 2 million** records (plus massive streaming) | “Hot Pink” (2019) and the viral hit “Say So” pushed her into the best‑selling tier, though most of her numbers are streaming‑driven. |

\* *Sales figures are rounded estimates drawn from RIAA certifications, IFPI/World Music Reports, and reputable music‑industry press (Billboard, Rolling Stone, etc.). Streaming‑equivalent album units are included where the reporting source aggregates them into “record sales.”*

### Quick take‑aways

- **All of the top‑selling female rappers are either from the United States or grew up there**, with the notable exception of Iggy Azalea, who was born in Australia and later moved to the U.S. to launch her career.  
- **The U.S. East Coast (New York in particular) dominates the list** – five of the eight rappers above were born or raised in New York City.  
- **International representation is limited**: apart from Nicki Minaj’s Caribbean birthplace and Iggy Azalea’s Australian roots, the highest‑selling female rappers have built their commercial success largely within the American market.  

If you need deeper detail on any artist—certification breakdowns, year‑by‑year sales, or streaming numbers—just let me know!
